name: Puls8
description: Above the street, the water stays warm and the lights stay low. Puls8 is a rooftop lounge and pool for late hours: dark colors, neon accents, and a pool that looks better after midnight. High enough to feel private. Rough enough that you do not have to behave.

events.title: PULS8 PRESENTS: MYSPACE ERA
events.blurb:
online status: emotionally unstable

BRING BACK THE CHAOS.

We're taking it back to the 2000s — when the eyeliner was heavy, the fringes covered one eye, the playlists were full of angst, and every profile had a questionable song playing on autoplay


So grab your eyeliner, update your imaginary profile, and get ready to make 2007 jealous.
